title: Syncs
description: Every completed sync on the instance: outcomes, durations, rows affected, retries and failures, by Pipe and by Pipeline. Time filters apply to completed syncs. Data visibility follows the selected PostgreSQL data source permissions. No raw sync messages or SQL are read by these panels.

list.name: schema
list.label: Internal schema
list.definition: SELECT table_schema AS __text, table_schema AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name, 'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid = (quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name))::regclass) GROUP BY table_schema ORDER BY CASE WHEN table_schema='_mrsm_internal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, table_schema
list.query: SELECT table_schema AS __text, table_schema AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name, 'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid = (quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name))::regclass) GROUP BY table_schema ORDER BY CASE WHEN table_schema='_mrsm_internal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, table_schema

list.name: metrics_table
list.label: Instance schema
list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' THEN 'Default instance' ELSE substr(table_name,length('mrsm_engine_metrics_')+1) END AS __text, table_name AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=${schema:sqlstring} AND (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name,'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid = (quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name))::regclass) ORDER BY table_name
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' THEN 'Default instance' ELSE substr(table_name,length('mrsm_engine_metrics_')+1) END AS __text, table_name AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=${schema:sqlstring} AND (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name,'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid = (quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name))::regclass) ORDER BY table_name

list.name: pipeline
list.label: Pipeline
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' AS __text, snapshot->>'name' AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m ON m.run_id=r.run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) AND snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT '(No Pipeline)', '(No Pipeline)' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' AS __text, snapshot->>'name' AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m ON m.run_id=r.run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) AND snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT '(No Pipeline)', '(No Pipeline)' ORDER BY 1

list.name: pipe
list.label: Pipe
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT 'Pipe(''' || connector_keys || ''', ''' || metric_key || '''' || CASE WHEN location_key IS NULL OR location_key = 'None' THEN '' ELSE ', ''' || location_key || '''' END || CASE WHEN split_part(pipe_ref, '|', 1) = ${default_instance:sqlstring} THEN '' ELSE ', instance=''' || split_part(pipe_ref, '|', 1) || '''' END || ')' AS __text, pipe_ref AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT 'Pipe(''' || connector_keys || ''', ''' || metric_key || '''' || CASE WHEN location_key IS NULL OR location_key = 'None' THEN '' ELSE ', ''' || location_key || '''' END || CASE WHEN split_part(pipe_ref, '|', 1) = ${default_instance:sqlstring} THEN '' ELSE ', instance=''' || split_part(pipe_ref, '|', 1) || '''' END || ')' AS __text, pipe_ref AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Syncs" FROM selected

panels.description: Inserted + updated + upserted + deleted rows. Replacements count both deletion and writing; unchanged fetched or checked rows are excluded.

  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Write rate
panels.description: Rows affected divided by total measured sync duration. Concurrent sync durations are summed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), sum(COALESCE(rows,0)) / NULLIF(sum(duration_seconds),0) AS "Rows affected/s" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "Failure rate" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)

  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), sum(greatest(attempts-1,0)) AS "Retries", sum(chunks) AS "Chunks" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, 'Pipe(''' || m.connector_keys || ''', ''' || m.metric_key || '''' || CASE WHEN m.location_key IS NULL OR m.location_key = 'None' THEN '' ELSE ', ''' || m.location_key || '''' END || CASE WHEN split_part(m.pipe_ref, '|', 1) = ${default_instance:sqlstring} THEN '' ELSE ', instance=''' || split_part(m.pipe_ref, '|', 1) || '''' END || ')' AS pipe_label, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT pipe_label AS "Pipe", count(*) AS "Syncs", round(avg(duration_seconds)::numeric,3) AS "Average seconds", round(max(duration_seconds)::numeric,3) AS "Maximum seconds", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS "Failures", sum(COALESCE(rows,0)) AS "Rows affected", sum(greatest(attempts-1,0)) AS "Retries" FROM selected GROUP BY pipe_ref, pipe_label ORDER BY avg(duration_seconds) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent failures
panels.description: Telemetry records outcomes and timing; open the corresponding run or job in the console for logs.

targets.rawSql:

  SELECT m.*, 'Pipe(''' || m.connector_keys || ''', ''' || m.metric_key || '''' || CASE WHEN m.location_key IS NULL OR m.location_key = 'None' THEN '' ELSE ', ''' || m.location_key || '''' END || CASE WHEN split_part(m.pipe_ref, '|', 1) = ${default_instance:sqlstring} THEN '' ELSE ', instance=''' || split_part(m.pipe_ref, '|', 1) || '''' END || ')' AS pipe_label, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)

  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)

  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))

  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))

    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), pipe_label AS metric, avg(duration_seconds) AS value FROM selected GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recorded run durations
panels.description: Observed wall-clock duration from persisted run history. Unfinished runs show elapsed time; selected sync events determine which runs appear.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT r.run_id AS "Run", r.started AS "Started", r.finished AS "Finished", r.success AS "Succeeded", extract(epoch FROM (COALESCE(r.finished,now())-r.started)) AS "Wall seconds", r.num_nodes AS "Nodes", r.workers AS "Workers"
FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected s WHERE s.run_id=r.run_id) ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 100
